Per capita burden of loans
†*441. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the per capita burden of loans
in the country as on date;
(b) the amount paid against interest on
loans during the last three years and current
financial year so far; and
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by Government to reduce the same?
Rationalisation of tariff regime
*442. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that for several
product lines, the existing tariff regime
results in higher import duty rate on raw
materials/intermediates than on finished
products, thereby discouraging value addition
by domestic manufacturers;
(b) whether the Ministry have a list of
all product lines, which face inverted duty
structure;
(c) what action is proposed to
rationalize the tariff regime to address this
anomaly; and
(d) whether Government propose to do
away with Early Harvest List in Regional
Trading Agreements (RTAs) as the Early
Harvest List of goods in RTAs create
inverted duty structure?
Allotment of petrol pumps to
dependants of Kargil war
martyrs
†*443. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA:  Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have formulated a plan to allot dealership of
petrol pumps and LPG to the widows of the
brave martyrs of Kargil war;
(b) if so, how many widows/dependants
of martyr soldiers have been allotted

dealership of petrol pumps and LPG till
date and how many of them are still left;
and

Madhya Pradesh allotted petrol pumps and
LPG dealership?

Rajasthan
*444. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:

gas required every month in Rajasthan;

LPG meant for domestic consumption is

cleared?

Certificate of AI
*445. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the governing
body for global airlines, International Air
Transport Association (IATA) has cancelled
Air India's Operation Safety Certificate for
failing to meet International Operations
Safety Audit (IOSA) standards; and
(b) whether Government have made any
investigations to find out why the Indian flag
carrier has failed to meet IOSA and if so,
the action proposed?

Departments under M/o Civil Aviation

RASHTRAPAL:  Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:

March, 2004 in various Departments under

guidelines/rules to address the grievances

(c) what is the action plan of Government
to control addition of unjustified charges and
making of harassing calls by the bank
officials, etc.?

Financial package for Himachal
Pradesh
*448. SHRI SURESH BHARDWAJ:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the status/position of the financial
package/assistance announced by the Prime
Minister for Himachal Pradesh on the 28th

(b) the number of schemes sanctioned

year 2005- 06 by the Central Government?
Package for Rural Co-operatives
*449. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:

number of co-operatives and number of co-
operatives to be benefited by above fund

operative credit, accumulated loss, invoked

New oil exploration
*450. PROF. P.J. KURIAN: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) what are Government's plans to
increase exploration in India by various PS
Units involved in oil exploration;
(b) whether there is any formula fixed
by Government on the financial ratios on
domestic investment in oil exploration and
overseas exploration for oil;
(c) if so, the details of such ratios; and
(d) the steps proposed to emphasize
domestic oil exploration?
Staff strength of Global Trust Bank
*451. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons working in
each branch of the then Global Trust Bank
at the time when it was taken over by the
Oriental Bank of Commerce and what is
their present strength;
(b) whether it is a fact that some of
these branches are being run with the
skeleton staff of two or three persons only
and if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the work load in those
branches has increased since its taking over
by Government and if so, the reasons for
not increasing the strength of staff in those
branches?
Entry of LICs into Health Insurance
Sector
*452. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Life Insurance
Corporation of India has sought entry into
Health Insurance Sector;
(b) whether the IRDA has yet to clear
certain regulatory issues, if so, the details
thereof; and
(c) the steps taken to resolve the same?

140
Outsourcing of printing of currency
notes and coins
*453. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO:  Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made a
proposal to outsource printing of currency
notes and coins from different countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the problem of counterfeiting
has been addressed;
(d) if so, the details of measures taken in
this regard;
(e) whether ensuring the security and
safe delivery of print runs has been a major
problem; and
(f) if so, the details of the steps taken/
proposed to be taken?
Smooth management of airports
*454. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Govenment
have not extended adequate cooperation to
the Airports Authority of India in the matter
of immigration, passenger screening etc. by
various agencies like the CISF and other
such agencies;
(b) to what extent has such non-
cooperation resulted in poor service at
airports all over the country;
(c) whether Government would hold
meetings with the Airports Authority of India
to find solutions to routine problems of the
day; and
(d) the reasons for not putting in place
a modern and accountable system to help
smooth management of all airports in the
country?
Reservation of SCs and STs in M/o
Civil Aviation
*455. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
successfully maintaining the requisite
percentage of SCs and STs reservation in
jobs in the Ministry and its various
organisations;
(b) if so, the details of the status,
organization-wise;
(c) if not, the details of the backlog status
and steps taken to fill up the vacancies; and
(d) the reasons as to why the number of
ST representation in Indira Gandhi
Rashtriya Uran Academi (IGRUA) is less
as compared to SCs?
Reduction in cost of air travel
*456. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN:  Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether private airlines now account
for more than 60 per cent of domestic air
traffic;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether low cost of private airlines,
which are much cheaper than the Indian
Airlines/Alliance Air, is the reason for their
increase in domestic air traffic;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the steps proposed to be taken to
reduce the cost of air travel of Indian
Airlines/Alliance Air aircrafts;
(f) whether Indian Airlines/Alliance Air
propose to introduce no-frills flights; and
(g) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

received any proposals relating to irrigation
projects from the State Governments of
Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat
during the last two years;

sanctioned alongwith funds allocated
therefor, State-wise and project-wise; and
(c) if not, the details of such projects

BHEL's power project in Orissa
*458. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that BHEL has
clinched a Rs. 800 crore order for the
expansion of the NALCO's captive power
plant at Angul in Orissa;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that on
completion of the project, the installed
capacity of the plant will go up to 1200 MW,
making it Asia's largest captive power plant;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Evasion of customs duty on imported
cars
†*459. SHRI AJAY MAROO:  Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of cases registered with
regard to imported costly cars for which
custom duty has not been paid;
(b) the number of such cars seized and
the amount recovered as fine thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
check evasion of custom duty on the imported
cars?
Setting up of a National Heritage Sites
Commission
*460. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of TOURISM
AND CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up a National Heritage Sites
Commission to tender advice on heritage
matters;
(b) whether this decision was taken in
view of the inadequacies in the present legal
and institutional framework to address the
documentation and conservation of built
heritage in its broadest outliner;
(c) if so, what are the other main
objectives of this proposed Commission;
and
(d) by what time Commission is likely
to start functioning?

a blueprint to rehabilitate the eligible slum

airport;

(c) whether it is also a fact that recently
several planes had to be landed in emergency

(d) if so, the details thereof?

planes

SHRI  PYARELAL

Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
